description: This file defines the MenuScreen widget and associated classes for displaying and interacting with a restaurant menu in a Flutter application. It includes UI components for listing categories and items, showing item details, and adding items to a cart.

classes.name: MenuScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying menu categories and items in a scrollable list with grid views.

classes.name: _MenuCard
classes.description: Widget representing individual menu items, including image placeholder and tap to show details.

classes.name: _ItemDetailSheet
classes.description: Stateful widget for displaying detailed information about a menu item and options to customize and add to cart.

classes.name: _SpicePips
classes.description: Simple widget showing spice level as fire icons.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for each widget, handling layout and interactions.

methods.name: _showDetails
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet with detailed item info and customization options.

methods.name: _addonChip
methods.description: Creates a FilterChip for additional add-on options.
